This looks like a block on overseas or datacenter IPs, not a dead site. Check it in a browser from Japan or Taiwan and fill it in if it opens.

Y's Hotel旭川站前: https://yshotel-asahikawa.com/ (title 【公式】ワイズホテル旭川駅前) fails plain curl because the certificate chains to Let's Encrypt's new 'ISRG Root YR', which is missing from this container's CA bundle. With the official Root YR from letsencrypt.org added as a CA (verification still on), it returns 200. Current browsers should open it, but recheck once in a browser.
KOKO HOTEL: use the www host. https://koko-hotels.com/... redirects to http://www... and returns 403, while https://www.koko-hotels.com/asahikawa_station/ returns 200.
